# Condé Nast Traveler Readers Name Viking #1 for Rivers and #1 for Oceans for Sixth Consecutive Year


October 06, 2026 8:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_183d5b45a7d58ec4ee35a65e088d4418/vikingcruises/news/2026-10-06_Cond_Nast_Traveler_Readers_Name_Viking_1_for_247.pdf)


*Viking Celebrates Six Years at the Top of the Readers’ Choice Awards*


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Viking® ([www.viking.com](http://www.viking.com/) ) (NYSE: VIK) has once again been voted #1 for Rivers and #1 for Oceans by *Condé Nast Traveler* in the publication’s 2026 Readers’ Choice Awards. This marks the sixth consecutive year Viking has been rated at the top of both the river and ocean categories.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261006688342/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261006688342/en/)


For the sixth consecutive year, Viking has been voted #1 for Rivers and #1 for Oceans by Condé Nast Traveler in the publication’s 2026 Readers’ Choice Awards. Viking is also rated as a “World’s Best” by Travel + Leisure—no other travel company has simultaneously received such honors from both publications. Pictured here, a Viking Longship sailing the Main River. For more information, visit www.viking.com.


“We are honored to once again be recognized by *Condé Nast Traveler* as #1 for Rivers and #1 for Oceans,” said Leah Talactac, President and CEO of Viking. “To be recognized as #1 in both categories six years in a row is a testament to the hard work and dedication of the entire Viking family. We are grateful to our guests for their trust and support and proud that our commitment to enriching, destination-focused experiences continues to resonate with curious travelers.”


Today's recognition is the latest in a series of honors for Viking. In addition to the awards from *Condé Nast Traveler* and *Travel + Leisure* , Viking was recently named to TIME's 2026 TIME100 Most Influential Companies list, which highlights organizations making an extraordinary impact around the world. The *Viking Vesta* ® was also named to *Condé Nast Traveler’s* 2026 Hot List. Additional accolades include Viking ranking #1 in seven categories in *USA TODAY 10BEST 2026 Readers’ Choice Awards* and earning top honors from *Southern Living* for both its river and ocean voyages in the publication’s 2026 cruise rankings *.*

**About Viking** Viking (NYSE: VIK) is a global leader in experiential travel with a fleet of more than 100 ships, exploring 21 rivers, five oceans and all seven continents. Designed for curious travelers with interests in science, history, culture and cuisine, Executive Chairman Torstein Hagen often says Viking offers experiences For The Thinking Person™. Viking has more than 450 awards to its name, including being rated #1 for Rivers and #1 for Oceans six years in a row by *Condé Nast Traveler* in the 2026 Readers’ Choice Awards. Viking is also rated a “World’s Best” by *Travel + Leisure* —no other travel company has simultaneously received such honors by both publications.
